# skinview3d

This directory contains the browser bundle from `skinview3d` version `3.4.2`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/bs-community/skinview3d
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/skinview3d/v/3.4.2
- Bundle SHA-256: `e2a60ce607f2169e24b18bfd6e5214113b66f30d92e23f9a021ebbd4b21c08d3`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

The bundle is kept local so the SkinSystem page does not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.
